name: Alé Cycling
verdict: Alé is a cycling-apparel brand of APG S.r.l. (near Verona, Italy), owned by Federico Zecchetto. Nothing found.
note: Italian cycling-apparel maker (alecycling.com); Jersey Partner of the UAE Tour, Official partner of the AlUla Tour, and kit maker of Fenix-Premier Tech (2026). Rating note: APG S.r.l. ownership documented via UEC (claim ale-apg-zecchetto-ownership); no state in the chain, no relevant record found.
